result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major content error and a minor layout inconsistency.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers displays an invalid delivery fee value 'eNaN delivery', which is a content rendering error.
issues.suggestion: Resolve the data calculation or source issue to display a valid, formatted delivery fee amount instead of the NaN error value.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row (Trattoria Piccol) shows inconsistent alignment and spacing compared to the first two cards in the horizontal carousel.
issues.suggestion: Enforce consistent horizontal spacing and alignment for all cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel to maintain visual uniformity.
